proposed_assessment.route: Diclofenac sodium / cancer-cell microtubule and autophagy disruption
proposed_assessment.disposition: Retain in-vitro anticancer comparator and5-FU combination signal; no normal-function, MVA rescue or established exposure bridge
proposed_assessment.rationale: Diclofenac sodium perturbs HeLa mitosis/microtubules and HepG2 autophagy-associated trafficking, and reduces tetrazolium viability signals. Pancreatic-cell combinations with 5-FU use 1–2.5 µM diclofenac and have lower tetrazolium signals versus vehicle, including some conditions with little single-agent effect; universal superiority over the stronger single agent and formal synergy are unestablished. Source-reported 200 µM half-maximal lethality is not a verified 50%-viability concentration: Figure1G retains about75% signal and effect normalization is unspecified. Separate18h HeLa series differ. No normal-cell, animal/PK or BUB1B response measurement establishes a therapeutic window or MVA rescue.
